text_block_list.text:
When I arrive in the waiting room, I see
Mejiro
Ryan furiously doing squats.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You know it! My results from the last
race are still
bothering me...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
The bigger the load I take on like this,
the
tougher my muscles will get!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
And I bet the same goes for my mind
too!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It's 'cause I lost that I can overcome my

frustration and continue to improve!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm stronger than I was before—today I'll
win!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
